# Fisher

## Become a Fisher

Montblanc Cricket dives for a lost city of gold every day and comes up with fish instead.

Choose Fisher as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Fisher

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Fisher XP +300

<a id="q-2bbc1fcbe7e72967"></a>

## Apprentice Fisher

Bait, patience and a strong line.

Reach Fisher level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Fisher](fisher.md#q-17650bdfb86ed0da)

**Tasks**

- Reach Fisher level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Fisher XP +800

## Journeyman Fisher

Jaya's waters hide strange catches and stranger salvage. Fish up a Lovely Angel and a pearl that will not close.

Reach Fisher level 25, Fish up a Lovely Angel, Fish up a Treasure Pargai and land on a jungle island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Fisher](fisher.md#q-2bbc1fcbe7e72967)

**Tasks**

- Reach Fisher level 25
- Fish up a Lovely Angel
- Fish up a Treasure Pargai
- Land on a jungle island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Fisher XP +3,000

<a id="q-1a8772c31afae2db"></a>

## Expert Fisher

Hook a Sea King and stay afloat. Then go looking for the Golden Whale.

Reach Fisher level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Fisher](fisher.md#q-38ce8a6d8aaf49b7)

**Tasks**

- Reach Fisher level 50
- Hook a Sea King and stay afloat
- Land the Golden Whale

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Fisher XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-46b1241e8106868d"></a>

## Master Fisher

The best angler on the seas is the one the Sea Kings fear.

Reach Fisher level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Fisher](fisher.md#q-1a8772c31afae2db)

**Tasks**

- Reach Fisher level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
